versions.changelog: No user-facing changes in this release; metadata/file version updated only.

- Improved formula anchoring, recalculation, and model traceability based on findings from a stricter external spreadsheet audit.
- Updated description and guidance for handling formulas, formatting, dates, and workbook preservation.
- Expanded documentation on common workflow traps and best practices.
- Added related skills and usage instructions.
- Clarified when to use this skill versus alternatives like pandas or CSV workflows.
